preconditions.description: The size of the array a must be between 1 and 100000.
The number of queries must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 100000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in the array a must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r in queries if query_type == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, l and r must be valid indices within the array bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 100000 for k in queries if query_type == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, k must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for p in queries if query_type == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, p must be a valid index within the array bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 100000 for x in queries if query_type == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, x must be between 1 and 100000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(cnt_i > 0 for cnt_i in counts) else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to choose k distinct integers, output -1.
Output the minimum value of dif that satisfies the conditions for type 1 queries.
